news.body:
## Two decisions sitting on the board
- Amazon Pathways, the operations LDP, dated 15 November.
It is a rolling posting with no deadline, which comes down when they have enough people, so the date on the board is a prompt rather than theirs. Accept it and it becomes an ordinary task; reject it and it goes.
- The MBB pre-MBA programmes are closed for your intake.
Make Your Mark, BCG Unlock and ExperienceBain all run over the summer for people starting in the autumn, so the January window has gone. The route from here is the on-campus cycle in P1, which is a calendar to pin down rather than an application to chase.

## The nearest date is your CV
- Upload your CV to VMock, 18 October.
Nothing else on the board is dated before it and it is a short job. The score is what tells you what to fix, and the INSEAD CV itself is due 2 November, so doing it this weekend leaves two clear weeks to act on what it says.

## Business Foundations needs an answer before the bank gives you one
- Registration closes 30 October. You are holding it for the SBI sanction, due 24 October.
That is six days of margin on an optional quant primer that runs 16 to 20 November online. If the sanction slips past the 24th, do you register anyway and carry the cost, or let the course go?
